name: DENDengueCustomCodes
title: DEN Custom Codes
description: Single local code system for DEN project concepts that need a local representation. Concepts are preserved from the source data dictionaries; candidate external mappings are maintained separately and are not asserted as exact equivalences.

concept.definition: DEN.C3.DE3 response option from the data dictionary.
DEN.C3.DE4 response option from the data dictionary.
DEN.C3.DE5 response option from the data dictionary.
DEN.C3.DE6 response for no danger sign; kept local because the supplied SNOMED CT qualifier is not an exact match.
DEN.C3.DE7 Observation code used pending resolution of conflicting LOINC codes in the source material.
DEN.C4.DE1 concept from the source data dictionary: signs and symptoms consistent with dengue.
DEN.C4.DE2 concept from the source data dictionary: dengue diagnosis confirmed by laboratory tests.
DEN.C6.DE2 classification option: dengue without warning signs, special conditions, social risk factors, or comorbidities.
DEN.C6.DE3 classification option: dengue without warning signs, but with special conditions, social risk factors, or comorbidities.
DEN.C6.DE4 classification option: dengue with warning signs.
DEN.C6.DE5 classification option: severe forms of dengue with shock, severe bleeding, or organ dysfunction.
DEN.C7.1.DE1 question concept: whether hydration therapy has been initiated.
DEN.C7.1.DE2 response option: patient started oral fluid therapy.
DEN.C7.1.DE3 response option: patient started intravenous fluid therapy.
DEN.C7.1.DE4 response option: not indicated or not yet initiated; the source does not distinguish these cases.
DEN.C7.2.DE1 question concept: management category aligned with severity classification and available resources.
DEN.C7.2.DE2 response option: management provided on an outpatient basis.
DEN.C7.2.DE3 response option: closer monitoring than ambulatory care but not full hospital admission.
DEN.C7.2.DE4 response option: continuous monitoring, IV fluids, complication management, and supportive care.
DEN.C7.2.DE5 response option: advanced monitoring, aggressive fluid management, blood products, and organ support.
